preserve: every email carries its plain text and its html drawn from the same words
a see-through look colour is laid over the paper colour, so every email client shows it solid
the action wears the look's primary button fill, sheen and depth
every kind of block the markdown reader makes is drawn, rules and code included
allowed_deltas: the markdown reader's helpers the email part uses are moved beside it, not the whole document page: marks (word-marks.json) are not drawn in an email, so wordsHtml draws plain words only

the look's roles and the shipped look are DATA (read-data/email-look.json), the shipped look being the older owner's starting look resolved for those roles, in place of its mail settings rows and page-look.mjs
the mark at the top and the made-with line are the account's own (its mail row's brand and made_with), not one service's

the worn look is read by a reader the caller gives (readLook); the email rows give none, so they wear the shipped look: the account's worn look is resolved from the app owner's look DATA, which a sending row is not given
the dark-or-light test of a look is page-look.mjs's lookScheme, moved beside the palette in place of brand-assets.mjs backgroundTone
banned_substitutions: a message sent as plain text when it should have been drawn
